# state of

The entity whose location state this is — the moving feature whose presence, pose, and velocity are described by this state. Functional: a state belongs to exactly one entity.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/stateOf>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:stateOf`  

**Type:** `owl:FunctionalProperty`, `owl:ObjectProperty`  

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/places>
